name: Mounted Sharpshooter

index.description_snippet: You fire firearms accurately from the saddle.

description_html: You fire firearms accurately from the saddle.
description_text: You fire firearms accurately from the saddle.
benefit_html: You take no penalty on ranged attacks with firearms while mounted (normally −4). You still need Ride checks to control the mount.
benefit_text: You take no penalty on ranged attacks with firearms while mounted (normally −4). You still need Ride checks to control the mount.

name: Expert Rider

index.description_snippet: You are an accomplished rider.

description_text: You are an accomplished rider.
benefit_html: All Ride task DCs are reduced by 2. You may take 10 on Ride checks for mounted combat maneuvers even when threatened or distracted.
benefit_text: All Ride task DCs are reduced by 2. You may take 10 on Ride checks for mounted combat maneuvers even when threatened or distracted.

name: Ride Bareback

index.description_snippet: You ride without saddle or bridle.

description_text: You ride without saddle or bridle.
benefit_html: You take no −5 Ride penalty for riding without a saddle or bridle.
benefit_text: You take no −5 Ride penalty for riding without a saddle or bridle.

name: Pistol Whip

index.description_snippet: You use a firearm as a melee weapon without breaking it.

description_html: You use a firearm as a melee weapon without breaking it.
description_text: You use a firearm as a melee weapon without breaking it.
benefit_html: Treat a firearm as a melee weapon without breaking it: Small as a light hammer, Medium as a club, Large as a warhammer.
benefit_text: Treat a firearm as a melee weapon without breaking it: Small as a light hammer, Medium as a club, Large as a warhammer.

name: Defend

index.description_snippet: You share your shield's protection.

description_text: You share your shield's protection.
benefit_html: While using a shield, allies within 5 ft. without a shield gain your shield's AC bonus. Allies within 5 ft. who also have shields gain +2 circumstance AC (does not stack with itself).
benefit_text: While using a shield, allies within 5 ft. without a shield gain your shield's AC bonus. Allies within 5 ft. who also have shields gain +2 circumstance AC (does not stack with itself).

name: Battle Language

index.description_snippet: You coordinate allies with battle signals.

description_text: You coordinate allies with battle signals.
benefit_html: Aid another for an ally who also has this feat within 100 ft. and line of sight as a move action. DC 15 Bluff: +2 circumstance to the ally's next attack or AC vs. the next attack.
benefit_text: Aid another for an ally who also has this feat within 100 ft. and line of sight as a move action. DC 15 Bluff: +2 circumstance to the ally's next attack or AC vs. the next attack.

name: Lightning Reload

index.description_snippet: You reload firearms faster.

description_text: You reload firearms faster.
benefit_html: A firearm reload that is a standard action becomes a move action; reloads longer than 1 round take half time.
benefit_text: A firearm reload that is a standard action becomes a move action; reloads longer than 1 round take half time.

name: Storm Bolt

index.description_snippet: You hurl a stunning bludgeon.

description_text: You hurl a stunning bludgeon.
benefit_html: Before a full attack with a ranged bludgeoning weapon, declare Storm Bolt. A hit deals nonlethal damage; Fortitude save (DC 10 + damage rolled) or stunned 1 round. Once/round; ≤ once/level/day.
benefit_text: Before a full attack with a ranged bludgeoning weapon, declare Storm Bolt. A hit deals nonlethal damage; Fortitude save (DC 10 + damage rolled) or stunned 1 round. Once/round; ≤ once/level/day.
prerequisite_html: Str 13, Bash, Power Attack, base attack bonus +4
prerequisite_text: Str 13, Bash, Power Attack, base attack bonus +4

name: Close Shot

index.description_snippet: You fire in melee without provoking.

description_text: You fire in melee without provoking.
benefit_html: You can fire a ranged weapon without provoking attacks of opportunity.
benefit_text: You can fire a ranged weapon without provoking attacks of opportunity.
prerequisite_html: Dex 13, Dodge, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, base attack bonus +4
prerequisite_text: Dex 13, Dodge, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, base attack bonus +4

name: Trick Shot

index.description_snippet: You ricochet ranged attacks.

description_text: You ricochet ranged attacks.
benefit_html: Bounce a ranged attack off one surface (moonglaive: up to two). Cover is measured from the final approach; range penalties use full path distance.
benefit_text: Bounce a ranged attack off one surface (moonglaive: up to two). Cover is measured from the final approach; range penalties use full path distance.

name: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (Thorium Weapons)

index.description_snippet: You are trained with thorium weapons.

description_text: You are trained with thorium weapons.
benefit_html: You are proficient with a chosen thorium weapon and add half your Strength bonus to its damage (one-handed 1½× Str, two-handed 2× Str).
benefit_text: You are proficient with a chosen thorium weapon and add half your Strength bonus to its damage (one-handed 1½× Str, two-handed 2× Str).
prerequisite_html: Proficiency with the non-thorium version of the weapon
prerequisite_text: Proficiency with the non-thorium version of the weapon

name: Devoted Leadership

index.description_snippet: Your followers fight harder near you.

description_text: Your followers fight harder near you.
benefit_html: Followers within (5 ft. × Cha bonus) gain +2 morale bonus to AC and +1 morale bonus on all saves for up to your character level rounds/day (max 20).
benefit_text: Followers within (5 ft. × Cha bonus) gain +2 morale bonus to AC and +1 morale bonus on all saves for up to your character level rounds/day (max 20).

name: Enduring Leadership

index.description_snippet: Your followers surge into battle.

description_text: Your followers surge into battle.
benefit_html: Once/day before an encounter, as a free action, followers gain +4 morale bonus on Initiative and +10 ft. speed for that combat. If you or they rage, those who rage are not fatigued afterward.
benefit_text: Once/day before an encounter, as a free action, followers gain +4 morale bonus on Initiative and +10 ft. speed for that combat. If you or they rage, those who rage are not fatigued afterward.

name: Precision Leadership

index.description_snippet: Your followers concentrate fire.

description_text: Your followers concentrate fire.
benefit_html: On a ranged attack, each follower gains +1 attack per 5 followers attacking the same target at once (same weapon kind, within 10 ft. × Cha bonus of you, target within 100 ft.). Damage from all hits is totaled before DR.
benefit_text: On a ranged attack, each follower gains +1 attack per 5 followers attacking the same target at once (same weapon kind, within 10 ft. × Cha bonus of you, target within 100 ft.). Damage from all hits is totaled before DR.

name: Follower of the Totem

index.description_snippet: You draw strength from ancestral totems.

description_text: You draw strength from ancestral totems.
benefit_html: Once/day as a free action, gain a +2 sacred bonus to any one ability score for 1d6+1 rounds. Tauren with this feat are treated as having Exotic Weapon Proficiency (tauren totem).
benefit_text: Once/day as a free action, gain a +2 sacred bonus to any one ability score for 1d6+1 rounds. Tauren with this feat are treated as having Exotic Weapon Proficiency (tauren totem).

name: Drums of Courage

index.description_snippet: War drums inspire your tribe.

description_text: War drums inspire your tribe.
benefit_html: DC 20 Perform (percussion): tribe warriors who hear the drums gain +1 morale bonus on attack, damage, and Will saves while the drums play and for 5 rounds after.
benefit_text: DC 20 Perform (percussion): tribe warriors who hear the drums gain +1 morale bonus on attack, damage, and Will saves while the drums play and for 5 rounds after.

name: Block Spell

index.description_snippet: You counter spells with raw magic energy.

description_html: You counter spells with raw magic energy.
description_text: You counter spells with raw magic energy.
benefit_html: When targeted by a spell, make a Spellcraft check (DC 15 + spell level) to identify and counter it by spending a spell slot at least 1 level higher.
benefit_text: When targeted by a spell, make a Spellcraft check (DC 15 + spell level) to identify and counter it by spending a spell slot at least 1 level higher.
prerequisite_html: Iron Will, Magic Energy Control, caster level 5th
prerequisite_text: Iron Will, Magic Energy Control, caster level 5th

name: Magic Energy Control

index.description_snippet: You prepare spells with greater efficiency.

description_text: You prepare spells with greater efficiency.
benefit_html: Daily spell preparation takes half the normal time. A high elf with this feat no longer suffers magic-addiction effects during preparation (prepares in normal time, not half).
benefit_text: Daily spell preparation takes half the normal time. A high elf with this feat no longer suffers magic-addiction effects during preparation (prepares in normal time, not half).

name: Mirror Spell

index.description_snippet: You cast a spell twice at once.

description_html: You cast a spell twice at once.
description_text: You cast a spell twice at once.
benefit_html: When casting an arcane spell, treat it as cast twice (both resolve simultaneously). Spend an additional spell slot of the same level or higher.
benefit_text: When casting an arcane spell, treat it as cast twice (both resolve simultaneously). Spend an additional spell slot of the same level or higher.
prerequisite_html: Iron Will, Magic Energy Control, caster level 3rd
prerequisite_text: Iron Will, Magic Energy Control, caster level 3rd

name: Deflect Spell

index.description_snippet: You redirect a countered spell.

description_text: You redirect a countered spell.
benefit_html: After successfully countering a spell, deflect it to any target as if you had cast it.
benefit_text: After successfully countering a spell, deflect it to any target as if you had cast it.
prerequisite_html: Block Spell, Iron Will, Magic Energy Control, Mirror Spell, Reflect Spell, caster level 9th
prerequisite_text: Block Spell, Iron Will, Magic Energy Control, Mirror Spell, Reflect Spell, caster level 9th

name: Reflect Spell

index.description_snippet: You bounce a spell back at its caster.

description_html: You bounce a spell back at its caster.
description_text: You bounce a spell back at its caster.
benefit_html: After successfully countering a spell that targeted you, reflect it back at the caster.
benefit_text: After successfully countering a spell that targeted you, reflect it back at the caster.
prerequisite_html: Block Spell, Iron Will, Magic Energy Control, Mirror Spell, caster level 7th
prerequisite_text: Block Spell, Iron Will, Magic Energy Control, Mirror Spell, caster level 7th

name: Build Siege Weapons

index.description_snippet: You craft and sabotage siege engines.

description_text: You craft and sabotage siege engines.
benefit_html: +2 Craft (technological device) for catapults, cannons, mortars, and other siege weapons; +2 technological limit. You may sabotage Large or larger tech devices.
benefit_text: +2 Craft (technological device) for catapults, cannons, mortars, and other siege weapons; +2 technological limit. You may sabotage Large or larger tech devices.

name: Build Firearms

index.description_snippet: You craft firearms.

description_text: You craft firearms.
benefit_html: +2 Craft (technological device) when crafting firearms; +2 technological limit for firearms. Once/week, with a firearm you built, declare an automatic critical threat (still confirm).
benefit_text: +2 Craft (technological device) when crafting firearms; +2 technological limit for firearms. Once/week, with a firearm you built, declare an automatic critical threat (still confirm).

name: Build Small Devices

index.description_snippet: You craft Tiny and smaller devices.

description_text: You craft Tiny and smaller devices.
benefit_html: +2 Craft (technological device) for Tiny/Diminutive/Fine devices; +2 technological limit. You may build concealed devices (Spot and Use Technological Device DC 10 + your Craft modifier).
benefit_text: +2 Craft (technological device) for Tiny/Diminutive/Fine devices; +2 technological limit. You may build concealed devices (Spot and Use Technological Device DC 10 + your Craft modifier).

name: Build Vehicles

index.description_snippet: You craft and operate vehicles.

description_text: You craft and operate vehicles.
benefit_html: +2 Craft (technological device) and Use Technological Device for vehicles; +2 technological limit. Once/day, double a vehicle's speed for 1d6 minutes.
benefit_text: +2 Craft (technological device) and Use Technological Device for vehicles; +2 technological limit. Once/day, double a vehicle's speed for 1d6 minutes.

name: Emergency Repair

index.description_snippet: You force a broken device to work briefly.

description_html: You force a broken device to work briefly.
description_text: You force a broken device to work briefly.
benefit_html: Full-round action, DC 20 Craft (mechanical object): a malfunctioning or broken tech device works for 1 hour, then stops until normally repaired. Natural 20 = permanent repair.
benefit_text: Full-round action, DC 20 Craft (mechanical object): a malfunctioning or broken tech device works for 1 hour, then stops until normally repaired. Natural 20 = permanent repair.

name: Delay Malfunction

index.description_snippet: You keep a failing device running a few rounds.

description_html: You keep a failing device running a few rounds.
description_text: You keep a failing device running a few rounds.
benefit_html: On malfunction, DC 15 Craft (technological device): the device works normally for 1d3 rounds. Natural 20 averts the malfunction entirely.
benefit_text: On malfunction, DC 15 Craft (technological device): the device works normally for 1d3 rounds. Natural 20 averts the malfunction entirely.

name: Vehicle Proficiency (Land)

index.description_snippet: You operate land vehicles.

description_text: You operate land vehicles.
benefit_html: You can operate land vehicles with Use Technological Device without the −4 nonproficiency penalty.
benefit_text: You can operate land vehicles with Use Technological Device without the −4 nonproficiency penalty.

description_text: You operate water vehicles.

benefit_text: You can operate water vehicles with Use Technological Device without the −4 nonproficiency penalty.

benefit_text: You can operate air vehicles with Use Technological Device without the −4 nonproficiency penalty.

name: Scavenge Materials

index.description_snippet: You build with scavenged parts.

description_text: You build with scavenged parts.

benefit_text: Build using raw materials worth 1/10 the item's market price; Craft DC +10.

name: Pulverize

index.description_snippet: You slam a totem to knock foes down.

description_html: You slam a totem to knock foes down.
description_text: You slam a totem to knock foes down.
benefit_html: Full attack with a tauren totem: strike the ground (roll damage for DC only); creatures within 20 ft. Reflex save (DC 10 + damage) or fall prone. Once/round; ≤ (1 + Wis bonus)/day.
benefit_text: Full attack with a tauren totem: strike the ground (roll damage for DC only); creatures within 20 ft. Reflex save (DC 10 + damage) or fall prone. Once/round; ≤ (1 + Wis bonus)/day.
